scope: Competition rules research only. No legal acceptance, account change, public upload, competition entry or final submission performed. No previous release modified.

verification_layers.independent_indexed_retrieval: Official Kaggle overview/submission-requirements text retrieved with web search; several crawls were labeled last month. This independently confirms the document requirements, deadline, rubric and track distinction.
verification_layers.live_delegated_verification: Root agent reported reading the live overview and complete rules DOM with CUA at approximately 2026-11-12 06:07 UTC. Its explicit findings are recorded as delegated primary-page verification, not as text returned by the child web tool.
verification_layers.direct_open_limitation: Child web opens of overview sections, rules and several discussions returned zero readable lines or an access error. Those empty responses are not treated as evidence for the rules text.
verification_layers.historical_packet: The earlier local packet records a live-browser rules review and host replies dated 2026-11-12 UTC. Newly corroborated rules are distinguished from forum claims not independently re-fetched in this pass.

rubric.aggregation: equal arithmetic mean of five criteria

verified_constraints.mandatory_gemma_use_interpretation: No such requirement was found in the live paper-track overview or complete rules. This is not a guarantee that any unrelated systems paper will satisfy research relevance or judging quality.

conservative_editorial_decisions_not_rul: Keep the entire paper, including title, subtitle, headings, captions, tables and references, below 3000 words; no exclusion was verified.
Apply the same word ceiling to the PDF alternative; no PDF exception was verified.
Present actual implemented systems experiments as the contribution and mark Gemma-agent integration as unevaluated future work.
Treat public hosting and actual Submit confirmation as separate from local PDF creation.
Use the original code license notice; do not silently replace it merely because a conditional winner license is specified.
unresolved: Entrant age/majority and any applicable sponsor exception or consent, residence, sanctions/export and employer authorization.
Account/team history, daily submission count and final selections.
Authorship, rights, prior publication and ability to grant required licenses.
Whether a proposal with no completed experiments would be accepted; no explicit proposal-only permission located.
Whether reference/caption words are excluded from the cap; no exemption located.

Current specific host clarifications on AI assistance, arXiv/parallel submission, prior pilot publication, code hosting and notebook rerun expectations were recorded historically but not re-fetched in this pass.
Public project/notebook URLs, unauthenticated accessibility, actual entered/submitted status.

findings: Coding assistants allowed; entrant remains responsible for terms and submission.
Individual unaffiliated entrants may receive prizes; organizer addresses likeness accommodations.
Nonarchival; parallel submission and arXiv permitted.
Approval concerned one described prior pilot plus substantial extension; not blanket prior-publication approval.
GitHub sharing should work; external dataset permission still required.
Independent review permitted subject to licensing; no aggregate-only reporting restriction.
Notebook Run All need not execute an entire long pipeline; judges are not guaranteed to execute code.

historical_packet.current_status: Rules relevant to the rewrite corroborated by root live reading; forum-reply text not independently re-fetched here.

excluded_sources: Participant notebooks, unrelated competitions and third-party summaries encountered in search were not used as official rule authority.
copyright_handling: Concise factual paraphrases and links only; no complete rules or forum discussions republished.
